race.comment: GENEROUS HARRY (1) only got home by fine margins when resuming around Wyong but he got the job done and he can be all the better for having knocked the rust of there. He was able to follow up a fresh win with another at this point of last campaign and he might have just found the ideal race to double the dose this campaign. Looks the stable top seed but RANTAN (5) goes for the same yard with a genuine winning shot. Chased a smart one two back and then just bumped into a good Canberra horse set for the moment last time. Another nice Canberra horse turns up this time. ACTION KING (3) turned up in Queenland fresh, running well in a race that has produced three winners. He was one of them, bolting home on the Acton at Canberra and he should give another good account against these. MANUKAU (8) resumes with a chance and WINNING PROPOSAL (2) ties in with RANTAN from latest.
